title: Display phone number and address in public contact areas (Admissions + Footer)

requirements.summary: Show institute phone number and physical address (in addition to email) in the Admissions contact card and global footer, and render phone/email as clickable links when non-empty using the existing editable contact content (pageId: "contact").
acceptanceCriteria: On /admissions, the Contact Information card shows Address and Phone lines sourced from useContactContent() and does not hide them.
In the footer Contact section, Phone and Address are displayed alongside Email and match the same values shown on /admissions.
If phone is present, it is rendered as a clickable tel: link; if email is present, it is rendered as a clickable mailto: link.
No edits are made to files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths.

file_operations.description: Update the "Contact Information" card to render phone and email as clickable links when their corresponding values from useContactContent() are non-empty (tel: / mailto:). Keep Address and Phone lines always rendered (do not conditionally omit), and ensure displayed values remain sourced from useContactContent().

Update the footer Contact section so Email and Phone render as clickable mailto:/tel: links when non-empty, while continuing to display Address and Phone alongside Email (not omitted). Ensure footer values remain sourced from useContactContent() and therefore match /admissions.
